n_2060e137859e025c.name: Choose the recent hour
n_2060e137859e025c.source: export default function window({scheduledAt}){const t=Date.parse(scheduledAt);if(!Number.isFinite(t))throw Error('Invalid scheduled time');return{filter:'receivedDateTime ge '+new Date(t-3600000).toISOString()};}

n_c649f117211a016f.name: Prepare the Jira issue
n_c649f117211a016f.source: export default function fields({result,priorityIds}){const allowed=['[Technical]','[Account]','[Access]','[Billing]','[Product]','[Training]','[Feedback]','[Complaints]','[Security]','[Privacy]'];if(!result||typeof result.summary!=='string'||!result.summary.trim()||typeof result.description!=='string'||!result.description.trim()||!Array.isArray(result.labels)||!result.labels.length||result.labels.some(x=>!allowed.includes(x))||!Number.isInteger(result.priority)||result.priority<1||result.priority>5||!Array.isArray(priorityIds)||priorityIds.length!==5||priorityIds.some(x=>typeof x!=='string'||!x||x.startsWith('YOUR_')))throw Error('Invalid triage result or Jira priority mapping');return{summary:result.summary,description:result.description,labels:result.labels,priorityId:priorityIds[result.priority-1]};}

n_8eeaa573e69f2398.name: Remember the processed message
n_8eeaa573e69f2398.source: export default async function commit({messageId,issue},context){if(typeof messageId!=='string'||!messageId||!issue||typeof issue.id!=='string'||!issue.id)throw Error('Jira issue was not confirmed');const seen=await context.state.get('seen-outlook-support-ids');if(seen!==null&&(!Array.isArray(seen)||seen.some(x=>typeof x!=='string')))throw Error('Invalid saved message IDs');if(!seen?.includes(messageId))await context.state.set('seen-outlook-support-ids',[...(seen??[]),messageId]);return{};}
